editorial: Today, in the software world, projects focusing on autonomous agents and browser-based interaction capabilities stand out. The dataset and routing tools on GitHub show that developers are building new infrastructures to train these complex systems more efficiently.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: The exercise dataset (exercises-dataset) shared by Hasaneyldrm offers 433 different fitness movements with names, target muscle groups, equipment and visual instructions. This comprehensive resource provides a structured data infrastructure for those developing sports technology applications.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix is ​​an open source artificial intelligence-supported penetration testing tool developed to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in applications. This software, written in Python language, offers security improvements by analyzing system vulnerabilities through automated processes.

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.summary: The agency-agents project offers a software agency workflow by gathering artificial intelligence agents with different areas of expertise under one roof. The system aims to automate digital processes with agents with specialized characters, from front-end developers to content producers.

items.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice is a dictation application on macOS that performs on-device speech-to-text conversion and uses artificial intelligence-supported optimization models. It offers a privacy-oriented alternative with its local processing structure that does not require an internet connection.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute is a gateway that offers free access by combining more than 231 artificial intelligence providers into a single endpoint. It reduces token usage with advanced compression techniques, while optimizing developer tools with smart backup and multi-modal interface support.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: The video-use library is a Python framework that enables coding agents to automate video editing processes. This tool allows processing and editing visual content using programmatic methods.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.summary: AI Berkshire is a multi-agent-based framework that conducts value investment research using Claude Code and Codex models. It performs versatile analyzes on financial data, based on the methodologies of investors such as Warren Buffett, Charlie Munger, Duan Yongping and Li Lu.

items.title: Mebus/cupp
items.summary: Common User Passwords Profiler is a Python tool for creating targeted password lists. It prepares customized dictionary files (wordlists) by analyzing certain user data.

items.title: ripienaar/free-for-dev
items.summary: It offers a comprehensive list that brings together software as a service (SaaS), platform as a service (PaaS) and infrastructure as a service (IaaS) solutions that offer free tiers for developers. It provides up-to-date resources for professionals who want to reduce costs in DevOps and infrastructure development processes.

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.summary: The command-line interface (CLI) developed by Google makes coding assistants specialized in creating, evaluating and deploying artificial intelligence agents on Google Cloud (Google Cloud). This Python-based tool standardizes agent development processes and accelerates operational workflows on cloud infrastructure.

items.title: roboflow/supervision
items.summary: Supervision is a Python library that provides reusable tools and helper functions used in computer vision projects. It speeds up development processes by standardizing common tasks such as object tracking and visualization.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, herdr functions as an agent multiplexer running on the terminal. This tool allows users to manage multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously in the terminal environment.

items.title: simplex-chat/simplex-chat
items.summary: SimpleX offers a privacy-oriented communication infrastructure as the first messaging network that operates without using user identifiers. Developed with Haskell language, the platform aims to keep user data completely confidential thanks to its decentralized structure.

items.title: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.summary: Instatic is a modern self-hosted visual content management system (CMS) based on TypeScript. It allows users to run the content management interface on their own servers with a quick installation process.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Prepared by Microsoft, AI for Beginners teaches introductory topics to artificial intelligence through Jupyter Notebooks, with a 12-week curriculum. This content of 24 lessons offers a structured educational resource for those who want to learn basic concepts with applied examples.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Developed by Meta, Astryx offers a design system that is fully customizable and compatible with artificial intelligence agents. This TypeScript-based open source library configures interface components for the use of autonomous systems.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading offers a personal trading agent who makes investment decisions by analyzing financial market data. This Python-based project aims to manage automated trading processes by processing market sentiment and technical indicators.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers offers an agentic skills framework and software development methodology for artificial intelligence agents. This tool is designed to standardize agent-based workflows and structure software development processes.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.summary: Lingbot-map provides a feed-forward 3D foundation model to reconstruct scenes from streaming data. This Python-based project aims to standardize scene configuration in real-time data processing processes.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.summary: The Claude Code tool, developed by Anthropic, adds invisible data to the requests sent and marks them with the steganography method. This technique functions as a monitoring mechanism developed to track usage data of artificial intelligence models and manage security processes.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic has released an updated version of the Claude 3.5 Sonnet model, providing performance improvements in coding and reasoning capabilities. The new model expands the capacity to perform direct transactions via interfaces with computer use capability.

items.title: Department of Commerce has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
items.summary: The Ministry of Commerce lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models. This regulation frees the commercial access and use of these artificial intelligence models in international markets.

items.title: Claude Science
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Science, a tool designed to analyze complex data sets and validate hypotheses in scientific research. This tool aims to increase the capabilities of large language models in academic literature review and data processing processes.

items.title: Nano Banana 2 Lite
items.summary: Google announced the Gemini Flash Lite model, which is optimized for low-latency visual processing processes. This model was designed to perform fast image analysis on devices with limited resources.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Developed by Baidu, Unlimited-OCR is an image-to-text model that processes visual texts and produces text output. The system aims to accelerate the process of converting data in complex documents into digital format.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M model is a multimodal artificial intelligence model that produces text output by processing visual and text inputs. This model, presented in GGUF format, displays an optimized structure suitable for operation on local devices.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, published by Zai-org, is a language model developed for text-generation tasks. With its open source structure, it supports text creation processes in different application areas.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-35B, developed by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The model is presented in GGUF format for high-performance inference operations.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B
items.summary: Developed by Qwen, Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B was designed as a model focused on text generation. The model offers customized capabilities for artificial intelligence agents (AI agents) that can perform complex tasks.
